purpose: Passive input assessment for the C0 experiment; not an Altrego canon change or interactive requirements improvement.
unit: One unmodified upstream requirement document; same assessment applies to both arms.

rubric.criterion: Names the intended service purpose and its user or caller.
Describes at least one observable end-to-end operation, with its input and expected output or state transition.
Specifies the public interface sufficiently to implement calls: paths or entry points, methods, and required input fields where relevant.
States persistence and identity/authentication expectations where operations require them, or explicitly makes them unnecessary.
Provides observable success criteria beyond merely naming the technology stack.
Contains no unresolved internal contradiction that prevents implementing the described observable behavior.

rating: Each criterion is yes, no, or unknown with a document location and short rationale. No inference from evaluation tests, reference implementation, or eventual outcome.
acceptance: Accepted iff every criterion is yes. Unknown does not count as yes. Report criterion-level ratings as well as binary acceptance.
timing: Assess each selected document once before its first builder attempt; seal assessment before outcome evaluation. Do not change or enrich the brief, exclude a task, or alter the sampling order because of intake rating.
denominator: All five selected briefs, including rejected or unknown briefs and tasks whose attempts fail infrastructurally.
outcome_link: Report each paired task outcome beside the frozen intake rating and descriptive accepted/rejected-group counts. Five tasks cannot establish predictive validity.
